title: Core 12-Woman #25
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, twelve women in a single row.

A photograph of TWELVE women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 12 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render. Exactly 12 women, no more, no fewer.

Left to right:

Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Piercings: 150pc studs/amethysts/copper/sym. Jewellery: seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of rose-gold an anklet. Pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera. Shoes: extreme cobalt extreme platform high heels.

[Instagram glam / Legend Bust]: American woman, early 20s, bold and confident, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, long voluminous honey-blonde waves, a confident, camera-ready smile, high ponytail hair, oval nails (matte). an upper body dominated entirely by one mythologically enormous bust, far wider than her own shoulders, the defining feature. Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 12, catching each woman's own painted pattern and piercings distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
